cases.name: run-to-evidence linkage
assertions: an evidence record references an existing run
a result record does not become a claim merely because the run succeeded

cases.name: verification distinction
assertions: verification status is represented separately from execution status
peer completion or artifact presence does not imply verification

cases.name: provenance pin
assertions: material records can be traced to repository/ref/path/commit
scope and evidence references remain inspectable after transport

cases.name: replay safety
assertions: a repeated run identity cannot silently create a new equivalent effect
UNKNOWN effect state is not implicitly treated as safe-to-repeat

cases.name: authority separation
assertions: proposal/reasoning metadata cannot itself grant execution authority
authorization is represented outside model/tool prose
